correctness.rationale: Every R_n endomorphism is affine ux+v (recurrence from j▷(j+1)=j+2), including even n. Every nonempty subquandle is a coset of an additive subgroup; closure under reflections and the quotient H/2H gives the classification. For each U=c+H and any nonempty coloring into it, exactly n|H| of the n² endomorphisms land back in U, proving universal ungraded exponent n(n−|U|). For positive odd T(2,k), kδ=0, image order r|gcd(n,k) occurs with nφ(r) colorings. Counting u maps with output order s and v translations gives the displayed M_r with t_{0,1} exponent n/r, hence distinct monomials. Independent subquandle enumeration n=2..9 and complete graded affine-map enumeration n,k=(6,3),(7,7),(9,9),(10,5) reproduced each claimed exponent and coefficient.
